title: MSH-18 = 8859/1, message encoded in ISO-8859-1 with accented characters
tests: parser: conversion to UTF-8 according to MSH-18
values: lengths counted in characters, not bytes
knownBug: MSH-18 is ignored: the message is read byte by byte, without conversion to UTF-8; the XML outputs, declared UTF-8, contain ISO-8859 bytes (invalid UTF-8).
